en-US.description: A desktop floating bar that shows the status of Codex, WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, and Codeg sessions at a glance.
en-US.installationNotes: Connect your agent clients through Hooks / Webhooks in the settings before session states appear.
en-US.longDescription:
Agent Companion is a desktop floating assistant that gathers the status of Codex, WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, and Codeg sessions into a single floating bar. See at a glance which agents are running, awaiting your confirmation, or finished, and click to jump back to the original session.

Features
- Multi-agent sessions: shows running, awaiting-confirmation, and finished states with the session source.
- Desktop companions: 10 animal and 3 geometric companion styles with adjustable count and animation.
- Confirmation reminders: shows a prompt card when an agent needs your confirmation.
- Completion reminders: automatically pops up a card and marks the avatar when a task finishes.
- Session jumping: click the avatar or card to return to the original session when a link is available.
- Floating interaction: drag anywhere, hover for details, and click through transparent areas.
- Local settings: toggle listening per source, adjust appearance and startup, and manage the app from the tray.
- In-app updates: check, download, and install signature-verified updates from the settings page, with optional proxy support.
- Native monitoring: a Rust local service receives Hooks / Webhooks; no Node.js or Python is required at runtime.

zh-CN.author: zhangjia
zh-CN.description: 在桌面悬浮栏中集中显示 Codex、WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy 和 Codeg 的任务状态。
zh-CN.installationNotes: 首次使用需在设置中接入对应客户端的 Hooks / Webhook，悬浮栏才会显示会话状态。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Agent Companion 是一款桌面悬浮会话助手。把 Codex、WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy 和 Codeg 的任务状态集中到一条悬浮栏里：看一眼就知道谁还在工作、谁需要你确认，点击即可回到支持跳转的原会话。

功能
- 多 Agent 会话：集中展示运行中、待确认、已完成等状态，并标识会话来源。
- 桌面伙伴：10 种小动物与 3 种几何伙伴造型，可切换风格、调整显示数量与动画。
- 提问提醒：需要你确认时展示提示卡；可以关闭本轮提示。
- 完成提醒：任务完成时自动弹出卡片，并在头像上显示完成标记。
- 会话跳转：有可用跳转链接时，点击头像或卡片回到原会话。
- 悬浮交互：支持拖动、悬停查看详情；透明区域可点击穿透。
- 本机设置：按来源开关监听，调整外观与开机启动；通过托盘管理应用。
- 应用内更新：设置页检查、下载并重启安装签名更新包，可为更新单独配置代理。
- 原生监控：Rust 本地服务接收 Hooks / Webhook；打包后的应用无需 Node.js 或 Python。
zh-CN.name: Agent Companion
